headline: og-08-alt REBUILD — per-driver one-at-a-time withdrawal (full gold-standard 24 structures x 3 drivers x 8 subsets, 300 ticks): verdict=qualified, confound_resolved_per_driver_attribution. The original lumped (all-at-once) withdrawal gave ONE un-attributable collapse; withdrawing each driver ALONE (the other two held at full support) characterises each separately — a DIFFERENTIAL per-driver survivability the lumped run could not give. Full-innovation-set persistence when only that driver is withdrawn: gradient 0.041666666666666664 (hard_dependency), mineral 0.9583333333333334 (freely_survivable), feed 0.75 (borderline). So the confound is RESOLVED (confound_resolved=True): the hard dependency is ['gradient'] — the full innovation set rescues gradient withdrawal in only 4% of structures, and WHERE it does the required set is ['pump', 'heredity'] (pump+heredity attributed specifically to the vent pmf drive), while mineral access (96%) and feed (75%) are differentially survivable and require no specific innovation. This reconciles og-08's original {pump,importer,heredity} hypothesis — the lumped all-at-once run confounded it because the gradient (needing pump+heredity, rarely survivable) dominated; per-driver attribution shows the required set is DRIVER-SPECIFIC. The rich-integrated-world analogue of study 37's per-support attribution (there the pH/pmf gradient was the budget-sensitive hard dependency too). Metabolism = sustained A1 network, not autocatalysis (A2 refuted).
